## Is this a wire contract change?

The wire types come from the contract committed under `spec/typesafe-v1/` and are not hand-edited.
If this asks for something TypeSafe's API offers but this SDK does not — a new question type, a new
field — say so, with a link to where TypeSafe documents it. See
[Changing the API contract](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#changing-the-api-contract).
